name: Let us read
core_idea: This is a humorous play in which a mother advises her daughter to say the right thing at the right time.
supporting_evidence: However, when guests arrive, the daughter hilariously forgets her mother’s guidance.
Read the play to find out how she commits blunders and embarrasses the guests as well as her mother.

name: Let us learn
core_idea: I Study the following words taken from the text.
supporting_evidence: humorous, hilariously, coming, beautiful The given words are made by adding word endings like -ous, -ly, -ing, and -ful to the root words humour, hilarious, come, and beauty.
Such word endings are called suffixes.

supporting_evidence: Points to remember: • Allot a specific role to each member in the group.
